# KIWIBIRD

> > KIWIBIRD is a professional oral care brand offering innovative electric toothbrushes, water flossers, teeth whitening solutions, and dental hygiene accessories with advanced features like UV sanitization and smart pressure sensors.

KIWIBIRD specializes in high-quality, portable dental care products designed for sensitive teeth and comprehensive oral hygiene. The product lineup ranges from compact electric toothbrushes to cordless water flossers with UV sanitization technology, complemented by teeth whitening kits and accessories.

## Key Topics

- Electric Toothbrush
- Water Flosser
- UV Sanitization
- Teeth Whitening
- Sensitive Teeth Care
- Portable Dental Care
- K5 Sonic Toothbrush
- H1 & C1 Water Flossers
- UVC Sterilization
- Smart Pressure Sensor
- Dental Hygiene
- Oral Care Products
- Travel-Friendly Devices
- LED Whitening Technology
- Rechargeable Batteries

## Featured Products

- [KIWIBIRD K5 Sonic Electric Toothbrush](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/electric-toothbrush-k5-pink): Premium sonic toothbrush with 15 brushing modes, smart pressure sensor, and 300-day battery runtime.
- [KIWIBIRD H1 Portable Water Flosser](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-cordless-advanced-water-flosser-with-uv-mode-waterproof-and-portable): Cordless water flosser with UV sanitization and 30-day battery life for on-the-go oral care.
- [KIWIBIRD C1 Portable Water Flosser](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-c1-portable-water-flosser-green): Compact water flosser featuring 3 modes, UV sanitization, and extended 30-day battery.
- [KIWIBIRD K5OV Sonic Electric Toothbrush](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-oscillation-vibration-sonic-toothbrush): Dual-mode sonic toothbrush with oscillation and vibration settings for morning and evening routines.
- [KIWIBIRD K1 Mini Electric Toothbrush](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/electric-toothbrush-k1mini-white): Ultra-quiet compact toothbrush with rechargeable battery and intelligent pressure sensor technology.

## Teeth Whitening Solutions

- [KIWIBIRD R1 LED Teeth Whitening Kit](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-r1-wireless-professional-teeth-whitening-kit): Professional 15-minute LED whitening system with 5 Blue LED technology for effective results.
- [KIWIBIRD 3D Professional Whitestrips](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-3d-professional-effects-whitestrips-teeth-whitening-strips-kits-14-strips-7-count-pack): Professional whitening strips with 7D film technology for convenient at-home teeth brightening.
- [KIWIBIRD Teeth Whitening Pen](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-teeth-whitening-pen): Portable teeth whitening pen for on-the-go brightening and touch-ups throughout the day.

## Accessories & Oral Care

- [KIWIBIRD S1 UVC Toothbrush Sanitizer](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-toothbrush-covers): UVC sterilizer that eliminates 99.9% of bacteria from toothbrushes for enhanced hygiene.
- [KIWIBIRD Brush Head for K5 & K5OV](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/anti-sensitive-wide-brush-head): Replacement brush head with ultra-soft bristles designed for K5 and K5OV toothbrushes.
- [KIWIBIRD Water Flosser Replacement Nozzle Tips](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/kiwibird-water-flosser-replacement-nozzle-tips): Replacement nozzle tips compatible with H1 and C1 water flosser models.
- [KIWIBIRD Mouthwash for Sensitive Teeth](https://www.kiwibird.com/products/mouthwash-for-sensitive-teeth): Herbal mouthwash formulation specifically developed for sensitive teeth care and protection.
